title: providers.csv names GitLab as the organisation of gitlab.com, a repository host, so every gitlab.com project's row gets publisher GitLab
goal: the gitlab row of _tools/providers.csv (match gitlab.com/) has an empty organisation cell, as ST-wiv62ohc gate g4 decides for hosts that hold many owners' repositories, so kbid.py add takes a gitlab.com project's publisher from its page's site name or refuses for --publisher; docs.gitlab.com keeps GitLab. Found by the SP-b36246xo review (S3).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import provider as p;r=[x for x in p.providers(None) if x['match']=='gitlab.com/'][0];print(r['organisation']);sys.exit(1 if r['organisation'] else 0)
